mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and a rise in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high housing market activity, as measured by rising housing starts and residential sales, consumer spending and economic confidence increase, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending, as measured by rising residential sales, signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 3.0% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% year-over-year, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized, as measured by the quarterly GDP series, indicates a slowing economy that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
